expectations.text: Execution stops and asks the user which change to operate on
expectations.evidence: The transcript shows the agent found two active change dirs (add-farewell and refactor-hello) and, instead of stopping to ask the user which one to operate on, unilaterally decided 'The active change is add-farewell' and proceeded to implement section 1, later reporting 'Implemented section 1 of add-farewell' with no question posed to the user.
expectations.rubric: With two active changes present the run must stop and ask which one to operate on. 'Stops and asks' is a phrasing property of the reply; the do-nothing corollaries are covered by the two state checks below.

expectations.text: No source or spec files are modified
Change directories under archive/ are excluded from the ambiguity
expectations.evidence: The transcript's search explicitly excludes archive with `-g '!openspec/changes/archive/**'`, and concludes 'The active change is `add-farewell`' after finding two active dirs (add-farewell, refactor-hello), never treating `archive/2026-01-add-punctuation` as a candidate; the final git state confirms 'active change dirs (excluding archive)' lists only add-farewell and refactor-hello.
expectations.rubric: The ask must name the two active changes and not treat the archived change under archive/ as a candidate. Requires reading which changes the reply enumerates.
